fence_restated: the six invocations are CHARACTERIZATION ONLY. Results are NOT admissible as gate satisfaction, count toward no pass, and close no flake id. Every run is recorded, PASSES INCLUDED — a characterization that records only failures cannot establish a rate (3n).

hypotheses.name: SHARED_MUTABLE_STATE_IN_THE_MODULE
hypotheses.claim: a fixture, browser context, or artefact directory outlives a test and leaks into the next
hypotheses.confirms: failures depend on WHICH tests ran before them — the same test passes alone and fails after siblings, and the failing SET changes when order changes
hypotheses.refutes: a single test fails ALONE, in a fresh process, with nothing before it

hypotheses.name: ISOLATION_SIGNATURE_GENUINELY_MOVED

hypotheses.confirms: repeated isolated runs of the file fail at a similar rate
hypotheses.refutes: repeated isolated runs return 12/12; the 10/12 was a single observation

hypotheses.name: LOAD_OR_TIMING

hypotheses.confirms: failures appear only in the full suite and never in the isolated file
hypotheses.refutes: the isolated file fails with nothing else running

hypotheses.name: ORDER_DEPENDENCE_WITHIN_THE_FILE
